tx-dallas-2026-cdj7-anyiam-chika.bio: Judge of Texas Criminal District Court #7 since 2018, with 20 years of prior criminal law experience.

positions.stance: Dedicated to "modern criminal justice reforms" to identify those who may respond to rehabilitative assistance, use alternative sentencing, and enact bail reform for low-risk offenders.
"The most important thing when you go to court is a fair process and the opportunity to be heard"; committed to equal treatment and efficient administration of justice.
